harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Published node1’s approved release tree as the read-only rsync module `releases`. Node2 retrieved a persistent full copy with modes and symlinks intact. Write and traversal attempts are denied. Both nodes passed sequential reboot and recovery verification while retaining RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.
actions_performed: Installed RHEL 9.8-compatible rsync 3.2.7 on both nodes.
Configured and enabled node1’s rsync daemon on 10.100.50.10:873.
Restricted the module to `/srv/legacy2/rsync-module-publication/releases`, read-only and chrooted, with node2-only network access.
Applied persistent SELinux labeling and a source-restricted firewalld rule.
Retrieved the tree to `/srv/legacy2/rsync-module-publication/retrieved-releases` on node2 using archive semantics.
Verified matching file hashes, modes 0644/0755, and `current -> v1`.
Verified writes, an unexported private module, and `../private` traversal are denied.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Publish the node1 release tree as read-only module `releases`
evidence.summary: Shows the active listener, enabled service, exact module path, `read only = yes`, chroot confinement, and final healthy state.

evidence.requirement: Node2 retrieves the full tree with modes and symlinks intact
evidence.summary: Shows the retrieved tree, `current -> v1`, README mode 0644, client mode 0755, matching SHA-256 hashes, and a clean post-restart dry run.

evidence.requirement: Writes and access outside the module tree are denied
evidence.summary: Shows explicit read-only rejection, unknown-module rejection, confined traversal failure, absent write probes, and preserved private data.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the approved release and legacy operating platform
evidence.summary: Initial and final evidence confirms RHEL 9.8, unchanged kernel, preserved source hashes and symlink, and the private sentinel remaining mode 0600 with unchanged hash.
Healthy baseline boot ID 555221a1…; acknowledged native reboot; changed boot ID bdea7c10…; daemon, listener, security controls, source data, and end-to-end retrieval recovered.
Healthy baseline boot ID 910dc564…; acknowledged native reboot; changed boot ID fe7ab638…; retrieved data, rsync client, module connectivity, synchronization, and access controls recovered.
